efile.text: Withholding returns are submitted electronically through the Department's online services. Businesses that issued W-2s or 1099s that contain Iowa withholding must electronically file those documents by February 15.

epay.text: If you are a semimonthly filer, you are required to pay electronically.

returns.name: Iowa Withholding Quarterly Tax Return
contents: Due the last day of the month after each quarter; filed for each applicable period even with no wages (zeroes entered); semimonthly filers file it electronically after all six payments.
Credits (New Jobs Training and others) are shown on a withholding credit schedule.

returns.name: Iowa W-2, W-2G and 1099 electronic filing
contents: Businesses that issued W-2s or 1099s containing Iowa withholding file them electronically by February 15; no filing is required if no Iowa tax was withheld.

deposits.interpretation: Iowa sets the frequency from annual withholding tax: under $6,000 (under $500 a month) QUARTERLY: return and payment by the last day of the month after each quarter. $6,000 to $120,000 ($500 to $10,000 a month) MONTHLY: payments for the first two months of each quarter by the 15th of the following month, no separate payment for the third month, whose balance is paid with the quarterly return by the last day of the month after the quarter. More than $120,000 (more than $10,000 a month, more than $5,000 semimonthly) SEMIMONTHLY, electronically: the 1st-15th period is due the 25th of that month, the 16th-end period the 10th of the following month, six payments a quarter (the sixth due the 10th after the quarter), all before the quarterly return, which is due the last day of the month after the quarter. A due date on a weekend or holiday (Iowa Code 421.9A) moves to the next day that is not one. The frequency is an INPUT or is derived from the annual amount supplied.
